reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics was November 3, 2025.

Moss's Coastal digest of 11/2/2025 says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's own cutover recap from 12/8/2025 also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.

The same recap says she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 3 for the official change of ownership, or Nov 22 if the tracker records when Kwame actually started running it.
